Image editing tool: restore missing uniform/legs and remove incorrect rectangular alpha holes; preserve supplied identity, clothing, poses and 8 by 6 atlas arrangement

Image editing tool: reconstruct full standing frontal soldier from damaged top-left photographic reference, including both complete legs/boots. Used for relaxed frontal pose only. This includes generated reconstruction of missing details.

limitations: Edited derivatives approximate missing source details and are not exact reconstructions of lost pixels. Source atlas contains no independently filmed walking sequence. Frame/camera selection remains limited by supplied pose coverage.
